Historical discovery, fresh tree/replacement search or final portfolio computation: this preflight inspected archived file data and provenance only.

final_package_resource_checks.fixture_scope: Historical source/core and seed coordinate anchors only. Initial SPD/tree calculations are freshly executed and checked for matching spans, projections and costs. Reopening uses the original archived coordinates because degenerate SVD bases are not unique across LAPACK platforms. Every replacement search and final portfolio selection is freshly executed. Archived final approximations, replacement directions and final winners are not bundled in these fixtures.

installer.interpretation: Static installer text enforces offline binary-only installation, the six-package release lock as constraints, and checks every native command exit code. PowerShell parsing or execution was not performed.

metadata_refresh_scope: All current wheel metadata, tags, CRCs, dependency closure, lock constraints, installer bytes, source/resource hashes and dist identity were freshly checked. All four schema2 fixture arrays were freshly inspected for shape/dtype, finiteness, cost validity, source range and record counts. Historical computations were not executed by this preflight. No Windows execution was performed. Fixture sources, packet cores/specifications/history, and all twelve original seed-coordinate arrays and derived cost arrays were independently compared against the original checksummed v0.3 model archives. Seed raw-array SHA256 values are recorded. Archive decoding is file-data validation; no historical discovery, tree/replacement search or final portfolio selection was executed.
recommendations: Execute the installer and full verification on the declared Windows CPython 3.13 x64 target before claiming Windows runtime validation.
scope: Metadata and file checks only for the current Windows CPython 3.13 x64 wheelhouse, PowerShell installer, package source bytes, frozen historical backend hashes, and schema2 archived source/core/reopening seed fixture metadata. Windows execution was NOT performed.
